hints.content: A relative minimum point is a point that is lower than all other graph points around it. It's like the lowest point on a "valley."

The graph has two relative minimum points in the given section. One at $(-5,-6)$, and one at $(7,1)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A function is made up of line segments and curved lines. It starts at negative eight, negative three and decreases at a non linear rate to the point negative five, negative six. Then it increases at a non linear rate to zero, one. A line segment connects zero, one to two, seven and one-half. Then the function decreases at a non linear rate to the point seven, one. Then it increases at a non linear rate.
